Fort Kochi: fishing nets, heritage and the waterfront

Fort Kochi brings Kerala’s coastal heritage into a walkable waterfront setting. Traditional fishing nets and old streets make it a natural place to pause before a backwater trip.

Start by the waterfront

The fishing nets are among Fort Kochi’s best-known sights. Give yourself time to watch the changing light and harbour activity rather than treating the waterfront as a quick photo stop.

Explore the heritage streets

Kerala Tourism highlights the area’s heritage monuments and the colonial history of Fort Kochi and Mattancherry. Combine the waterfront with a relaxed walk through the surrounding cultural neighbourhoods.

Make room in your itinerary

A separate Fort Kochi sightseeing outing can sit alongside your Vaikom day. Ask the team about a local cab route and the stops you would like to include; the village tour and sightseeing arrangements should be confirmed separately.
